glyph.description: Short text used when there is no src.

angle.description: Degrees on the arc; 0 is right

at.description: Frame the item stamps in. Defaults to index times stepFrames.

bob.description: Bob amplitude in px (one logical px is 6).

confetti.description: Optional seeded confetti of 6 px squares.

x.description: Canvas px for the card top-left.

y.description: Canvas px for the card top-left.

anchor.description: Canvas px where the connector ends.

drawFrames.description: Frames for the connector to finish drawing.

bodySize.description: Body size in canvas px (default 24). Use 32+ for text that must read at review size.

rows.description: One entry per calendar day from startDate to endDate, ascending, zero-filled. added and deleted are the hand-ish daily counts; commits is optional.

highlights.description: Real commits to stamp in, chronological. subject is the real commit subject.

totals.description: Exact totals; the last row's cumulative values are forced to these at endDate.

endDate.description: ISO date of the last row. Informational; the last timeline key must land here.

timeline.description: Keyframes mapping a clip frame to a date. Linear between keys, so repeat a date to hold, and use close frames to speed up. The date index is floored for display.

freezeAt.description: Pause the timeline at atFrame on a highlight (by sha prefix) and draw a spotlight card around it. The timeline resumes after holdFrames.

date.description: Optional override of the spotlight day.

layout.description: Transparent date and counters, contain-fit to the authored box; full keeps the complete ledger.

binDays.description: Days per heartbeat bar. 11 gives 34 bars for the 374-day window.

scrollFrames.description: Frames a stamp list scroll takes.

channel.description: Channel name shown in the header, verbatim, for example "# announcements".

channels.description: Sidebar channel names. The one equal to channel is highlighted.

sidebar.description: Show the channel sidebar. false hides it and widens the chat.

fit.description: frame keeps the frame height. content hugs the window to the visible messages, snapping as they land, never below minHeight.

minHeight.description: Minimum window height in px for fit content.

messages.description: Messages in posting order. Adjacent messages from the same author, tag and time render as one block. lines are paragraphs. @everyone is a mention; {u:word} marks a word.

tag.description: Server tag shown beside the name, for example OSAI.

appearAt.description: Clip frame the message lands on.

dateDividers.description: Date dividers. A divider after the first flips through the days between the two dates over jumpFrames, then lands.

jump.description: Flip through the intermediate dates. Defaults to true after the first divider.

emoji.description: Unicode emoji, or a pixel icon URL or path.

onMessage.description: Message index to attach to. Defaults to the latest message posted by startAt.

joins.description: System join lines, in time order. Stacking accelerates when the at gaps shrink.

underline.description: Orange underline that draws in over 6 frames under the first matching word.

strike.description: Two-step strike-through. Rust on the frame at, orange offset by one frame after.

highlight.description: Vox-style marker swipe behind the word. A bar the height of cap height plus about 3 px either side, with 2 px stepped ragged ends, wipes across in 4 stepped frames.

circle.description: Rust hand-drawn ellipse around the word, drawn in 6 stepped segments.

annotation.description: Small Departure Mono callout card above the word, joined by an orange connector.

camera.description: Stepped integer push-ins of the whole window. Each step snaps on its frame; focus is in window px and lands on the frame centre.

badge.description: Mono label at the window's bottom-right. Empty string hides it.

frame.description: Window width, maximum height, corner radius, outline colour and hard offset shadow in px.

screen.description: {x, y, w, h} logical px of the screen inside the plate.

values.description: Keyframed targets. at is the frame (relative to the clip) when the flip toward text begins.

tileW.description: Tile width in px. Snaps to 6.

tileH.description: Tile height in px. Snaps to 6.

x.description: Anchor x in px. Its meaning follows align.

y.description: Top of the readout in px.

align.description: Which edge or centre of the strip sits at x.

label.description: Small mono caption above the strip.

stagger.description: Frames between neighbouring tiles starting to flip.

src.description: Static URL or public path. Managed media goes on clip.asset.

kind.description: a-roll, b-roll, hand, window or screen (slot card heading).

label.description: Corner label. Default PLACEHOLDER · REAL FOOTAGE · <slot>.

placeholder.description: True while the media is a stand-in; shows the label.

spec.description: Framing note for the slot card.

zoom.description: Crop zoom about focus (1 = cover fit).

focus.description: Fractions of the source (0..1) placed at the frame centre, clamped to the source.

push.description: Linear zoom to `to` over the clip.

mosaicIn.description: Pixelate in: {frames (8), from (48), steps?}. Starts at the coarsest block and resolves on hard steps.

mosaicOut.description: Pixelate out: {frames (8), to (48), steps?}. Coarsens over the clip's last frames.

faceZone.description: Canvas px box the talking head's face must sit in. Overlays must not cover it.

handMark.description: Canvas px of the palm centre (and palm width `size`) for a composite such as the mink on the hand.

guides.description: Draw the face zone and hand mark over real media too.

in.description: Seconds into the media where the clip starts.

volume.description: Deprecated: set the clip-level volume (`--volume`, clip.look(volume=...)); this param is read only when the clip has none.

sourceSize.description: Source WxH when the registry has no resolution.

background.description: The field behind the picture (and around the inset).

inset.description: Place the picture in a framed rect on the background field instead of filling the frame (a real screenshot shown as a document on the page). Canvas px {x, y, w, h}, radius (12), shadow (true = soft drop shadow, false, or a CSS box-shadow), border (CSS colour for a 1 px ring). zoom, focus, push and mosaic work inside the rect; the label hangs under it.

revealAt.description: Clip frame each level starts appearing.

px_scale.description: Screen px per cell. 6 matches the sticker grid.

x.description: Logical px from the left of the 320x180 grid.

y.description: Logical px from the top of the 320x180 grid.

stroke.description: Stroke thickness in cells (ring, underline, arrow shaft, rect outline). Defaults to 2, or 1 for rect.

fill.description: rect fill colour. Omit for a transparent (unfilled) rect.

outline.description: rect outline colour, drawn stroke cells inside the edge. Omit for no outline.

radius.description: rect corner radius in cells, pixel-stepped. 0 is a square corner.

blinkAt.description: Clip frame(s) where the shape hides for two frames, as am-sprite blinkAt. Without it the shape never hides.

frames.description: Frames for the wipe to finish. After that the end state holds.

seed.description: Seed for the random pattern. Same seed, same order.

zoom.description: Base zoom. A punch lifts it by one (capped at 4) for PUNCH_FRAMES frames.

focus.description: Logical px (320x180 space) at the view centre. Clamped to the plate.

mouth.description: Closed mouth line on the native plate; x,y top-left px, w width px.

skin.description: Hex fill that erases the plate's mouth and blink eyes.

lip.description: Hex, the dark opening and the lid line.

inner.description: Hex, the 1 px interior line inside an open mouth.

edge.description: Hex painted in the strip a bob uncovers at the top edge.

words.description: [start_s, end_s] word spans, seconds from clip start (Edge TTS word boundaries).

eyes.description: Eye anchors {x, y, w} (top row of each eye).

blinkEvery.description: Mean seconds between blinks (+/-30% seeded jitter). 0 disables blinks.

noBlink.description: [start_s, end_s] spans in which no blink may start.

seed.description: Seed for blink jitter, mouth-cycle offsets and bob phase.

bob.description: Logical px nudge (down) on the first frame of every 3rd word.

punchAt.description: Clip frames where the whole presenter snaps zoom+1 for 6 frames.

label.description: Placeholder slate text, shown uppercase bottom-left.

timecodeStart.description: HH:MM:SS:FF timecode at clip start; the REC timecode runs from here.

chip.description: Optional top-right status chip {text, swapTo?, swapAt?}. swapAt is a clip frame; the text swaps on that frame with a two-frame orange flash.

push.description: Slow continuous push {to, frames, at}: zoom moves linearly to `to` over `frames` from clip frame `at`. Give presenter and plate the same value. Prefer it to hard zoom changes.

stamp.description: {text, at, x, y, rotate (deg, default -4), size}

mark.description: {word, at}: orange marker on one attribution word.

src.description: Static URL or public path. Leave empty and use clip.asset for managed media.

zoom.description: Base zoom. presenterView caps it at 3; zoom 4 comes from a punch (punchAt).

focus.description: Logical px (320x180 space) placed at the frame centre.

pan.description: Logical px moved per step. Applies from the first step onward.

punchAt.description: Clip frames where zoom lifts one step for 6 frames (same as am-presenter).

bob.description: Nudges the view down one logical px on the first frame of stressed words (same as am-presenter).

words.description: [start_s, end_s] word spans in seconds, clip-relative. The bob and punch timing follow them, as on am-presenter.

seed.description: Presenter seed (bob phase) and random block-wipe order. Default 7 matches am-presenter.

fill.description: Assetless flat plate; a brand token or CSS colour. Existing asset and explicit background behavior is preserved.

push.description: Slow continuous push {to, frames, at}: zoom moves linearly to `to` over `frames` from clip frame `at`. Give presenter and plate the same value. Prefer it to hard zoom changes.

src.description: Static URL or public path. Leave empty and use clip.asset for managed media.

x.description: Logical px from the left of the 320x180 grid.

y.description: Logical px from the top of the 320x180 grid.

keyframes.description: Held poses. The last keyframe at or before each step is active.

slideDistance.description: Logical px the sprite starts away from its rest position; closes in 4 steps.

frames.description: Horizontal sprite strip. Frames advance at fps, quantised to clip frames.

blinkAt.description: Clip frame(s) where the sprite hides (or shows blinkIndex) for two frames.

blinkIndex.description: Strip frame shown during a blink when frames is set. Without it the sprite hides.

silhouette.description: true, or {until: frame}: draw the art as a flat ink silhouette (until that frame).

outline.description: {color, px (art px), pulse (frames)}: hard pixel outline, blinking one px wider every `pulse` frames.

look.description: Brand keeps the ruled pixel window; real uses a dark terminal with round window controls.

date.description: Verbatim date or the slot marker.

body.description: Verbatim post text only. Default is the slot marker.

highlightAt.description: Frame of a 4-step marker swipe across the body.

italicWord.description: First matching word renders in Gelasio Italic, rust #A94714.

italicColor.description: Colour of the italic word. Default rust (#A94714); on a charcoal field use orange (#FF7A2E).

underlineWord.description: First matching word gets an orange underline.

underlineAt.description: Clip frame where the underline starts to draw (6 frames).

x.description: Group left in frame px. Default centred.

y.description: Group top in frame px. Default centred.

scale.description: Integer scale of the window plus prompt bar. Default the one closest to 70% of the frame height (1 at 1080).

states.description: Keyframes. Each names the layers it changes; missing layers carry forward from the previous state.

prompt.description: Chat bubble below the window that types in from at. Null or omitted for none.

allAt.description: Frame where every layer mutates every two frames for twelve frames.

cursor.description: Pixel arrow that steps to the region about to change, a beat before each swap. path points are window px (the 960 px window, border included) at absolute clip frames; the cursor holds on each point, steps toward the next every stepFrames, and hides holdFrames after the last point.

keyframes.description: Increasing clip-local seconds with x/y/width/height in canvas pixels. Values interpolate linearly and clamp outside the range.

sourceSegments.description: Video playback sections starting at clip-local seconds; first at 0. Rounded frame boundaries must be distinct.

cardAssets.description: Optional card0–card5 overrides by timeline asset registry key. Hosts resolve managed media for preview and render; omitted cards retain the pack defaults.

revealDelaySeconds.description: Clip-relative delay before the complete overlay is revealed.

revealDurationSeconds.description: Fade duration after revealDelaySeconds; zero reveals immediately.

phaseDurations.description: Positive clip-local seconds for prep, iteration, anchors, and workflow.

timelineSegments.description: Ordered source timeline sections; start and end are seconds in the managed source video.

headings.description: Optional short headings for the four visual phases.
